steps.name: Tenant-qualified computed and stored balance comparison
criteria: Unscoped computed balances keep two tenants' same-named accounts as separate figures, not one merged sum
Unscoped books check enumerates accounts of every tenant, not only the pre-multitenancy tenant
Correctly funded tenants sharing account ids report balanced with no drift; a misstated balance in any one tenant is reported alone
Scoped (single-tenant) checks behave exactly as before; all existing tests stay green
steps.implementation_notes: RCA fix direction rca.md §3 steps 1-4, 7-8. Tenant-qualified account identity on the read side; account enumeration takes a tenant scope (unscoped = all tenants, tenant returned per row); legacy-tenant pin removed from VerifyBooks. Drift also gains a tenant field (additive, carried to wire in 01-02). Fakes and pact fake adapt to new port shapes; the scoped fake must still record the tenant it was asked for. Also GREEN: TestVerifyBooks_UnscopedCallChecksEveryTenantNotJustTheLegacyOne, TestProperty_VerifyBooks_UnscopedSharedAccountIdsAcrossTenantsAreNotDrift, TestProperty_VerifyBooks_UnscopedReportsExactlyTheOneAccountWhoseStoredBalanceDrifted. transfer_coordinator.go:540 adapts to the new All signature by passing ScopedToTenant(tenantID); behaviour unchanged. TestProperty_VerifyBooks_TenantScopedCallThreadsTheSameScopeToEveryRead (usecases_test.go:410-434) must stay green; it relies on the scoped fake recording lastAccountsAllTenantID. The Drift TenantID unit assertion (usecases_test.go:539-540) is added by nw-acceptance-designer after 01-01, not by the crafter. Contract shape: pure-function (return-only reads). EntriesFor unscoped out of scope.

steps.name: Drift rows name the drifted tenant over HTTP
criteria: Each drift row in the trial-balance response includes the owning tenant's id
Books balance YES for pre-multitenancy ledger plus a tenant each holding a funded treasury
Drift in one tenant's treasury is attributed to that tenant, never its same-named namesake
Drift in one of two ordinary tenants is found and attributed to that tenant alone
Existing consumer pact still verifies; response change is additive only
steps.scenario_name: Books balance when the pre-multitenancy ledger and a tenant each hold a funded "treasury"
steps.implementation_notes: rca.md §3 step 5.
